subject: pharmacology
title: Lithium Carbonate: Therapeutic Range, Toxicity, Nephrogenic Diabetes Insipidus and Ebstein Anomaly

steps.tx: **Lithium carbonate** remains bipolar disorder's reference mood stabiliser and its only agent with replicated anti suicidal effect, modulating second messengers (inositol depletion), neurotransmission and neuroprotective signalling by mechanisms still incompletely mapped. It prevents manic and, more modestly, depressive relapses in bipolar I disorder. Its pharmacology is elemental: a monovalent cation handled by the kidney exactly like sodium, which writes every interaction and toxicity rule in this lesson.
steps.say: Lithium is psychiatry's element: anti suicidal, kidney handled like sodium, and monitored like a religion.

vis.alt: Bipolar mood spectrum diagram showing manic, hypomanic, euthymic and depressive poles
vis.caption: The bipolar mood spectrum across which lithium's prophylaxis is prescribed and monitored.

steps.tx: The **therapeutic range** is famously narrow and level anchored: 0.6 to 1.0 mmol per litre for maintenance (0.8 to 1.0 often targeted in younger patients), up to 1.2 in acute mania, sampled 12 hours post dose at steady state after 5 days of stable dosing. Toxicity stirs above 1.5 and threatens life beyond 2. Baseline and serial renal function, thyroid, calcium, weight and ECG where indicated frame initiation, because lithium's chronic organ taxes (next steps) must be priced in advance.
steps.say: Twelve hour levels, point six to one point zero, five days steady; toxicity starts knocking at one point five.

left.title: Level discipline
points: 12 hour post dose sampling standard
Maintenance 0.6 to 1.0 mmol per litre
Acute mania up to 1.2 mmol per litre
Steady state after about 5 stable days

right.title: Baseline contract
points: Renal function, thyroid function, calcium
Weight, blood pressure, ECG where indicated
Pregnancy intention and contraception review
Level 3 to 6 monthly, organs 6 to 12 monthly

steps.tx: **Lithium toxicity** begins as an exaggeration of its nuisance effects (tremor, diarrhoea, polyuria) and climbs through coarse tremor, ataxia, dysarthria and confusion to seizures, coma and death, precipitated by dehydration, sodium depletion, thiazides, NSAIDs, ACE inhibitors and intercurrent illness, all reducing lithium clearance. Management stops lithium, restores volume with saline (which promotes lithium excretion), and dialyses for severe neurology, very high levels or renal failure, because lithium dialyses beautifully.
steps.say: Dehydration and thiazides poison lithium patients; saline and dialysis rescue them in that order.

nodes.label: Dehydration, sodium loss or clearance reducing drug
Haemodialysis for severe neurology or renal failure

steps.tx: Chronic renal tax number one is **nephrogenic diabetes insipidus**: lithium enters collecting duct principal cells through epithelial sodium channels and poisons aquaporin 2 trafficking, producing polyuria and polydipsia in up to a fifth of long term users, usually reversible early. Amiloride, which blocks that entry channel, is the elegant treatment that does not sacrifice mood stability, alongside lowest effective levels and once nightly dosing. Progressive tubulointerstitial nephropathy with slowly falling GFR is the rarer second renal tax after decades.
steps.say: Lithium floods the collecting duct and deafens it to ADH; amiloride locks its entry door.

left.title: Nephrogenic DI on lithium
points: Polyuria and polydipsia, nocturia prominent
Aquaporin 2 trafficking poisoned via ENaC entry
Amiloride blocks lithium entry into principal cells
Once nightly dosing and lowest levels mitigate

right.title: Long term renal surveillance
points: Creatinine and eGFR trended, not spot checked
Tubulointerstitial nephropathy after decades in a minority
Nephrology liaison when eGFR falls below 60 or declines
Stopping lithium late rarely reverses established damage

steps.tx: Endocrine taxes are predictable from lithium's glandular hobbies: hypothyroidism (commoner in women, monitored six monthly, treated with levothyroxine without stopping lithium), hyperparathyroidism with hypercalcaemia from a raised parathyroid set point, and weight gain. Teratogenicity headlines **Ebstein anomaly**, tricuspid displacement into the right ventricle, whose relative risk multiplies many fold while absolute risk stays small (roughly 1 in 1000 exposed), counselling arithmetic that deserves both numbers, never one alone.
steps.say: Thyroid down, calcium up, and Ebstein risk quoted relatively and absolutely or not at all.

left.title: Endocrine surveillance
points: Hypothyroidism: TSH 6 to 12 monthly, treat through
Hyperparathyroidism: calcium checked with renal panel
Weight and metabolic review at visits
Fine tremor and cognitive dulling dose reviewed

right.title: Pregnancy arithmetic
points: Ebstein anomaly relative risk high, absolute about 1 in 1000
First trimester exposure drives cardiac risk
Fetal echocardiography offered after exposure
Relapse risk off lithium is the opposing number

steps.tx: **Drug interactions** all translate through sodium: thiazides (worst), loop diuretics in volume depletion, NSAIDs and ACE inhibitors or blockers reduce lithium clearance and demand level rechecks within days of any change; sodium loading and theophylline increase excretion modestly. Sick day rules (pause during vomiting, diarrhoea or poor intake, check a level, restart when well) prevent most emergency presentations, and every lithium patient should be able to recite them unprompted.
steps.say: Anything moving sodium moves lithium; teach sick day rules until the patient recites them back.

nodes.label: New diuretic, NSAID or RAAS blocker started
Lithium level rechecked within 5 to 7 days
Vomiting, diarrhoea or poor intake: pause and test
Restart when eating, drinking and well again

steps.tx: **Valproate in mania** is the comparator that proves lithium is chosen, not defaulted: valproate loads rapidly by mouth or vein, suits mixed features and rapid cycling historically, and avoids level monitoring theatre, while charging weight, hepatic, haematological and the cabinet's worst teratogenicity (previous module). Carbamazepine is third line with its interaction empire. Choice among stabilisers is phenotype, organ reserve and reproductive planning arithmetic, which the next lesson completes with lamotrigine's depressive pole strength.
steps.say: Valproate loads fast and suits mixed mania; lithium endures for prophylaxis, suicide and cost.

vis.alt: SSRI and lithium action mechanisms diagram at the synapse
vis.caption: Lithium's intracellular second messenger actions beside serotonergic mechanisms, the stabiliser comparison in one frame.

steps.tx: **Stopping lithium** is its own hazard: abrupt discontinuation provokes rebound mania within weeks at rates exceeding gradual taper, so discontinuation (pregnancy planning, renal decline, patient choice) stretches over at least a month and preferably three, with relapse plans written in advance. Switching stabilisers cross tapers where pharmacology allows, remembering valproate and lamotrigine carry no lithium like withdrawal physiology, only relapse risk on their own clocks.
steps.say: Stop lithium over months, never days; rebound mania is the tax on haste.

left.title: Safe discontinuation
points: Taper over at least 4 weeks, preferably 3 months
Relapse action plan written with patient and family
Levels and symptoms reviewed through the taper
Alternative prophylaxis established first where possible

right.title: Unsafe patterns
points: Abrupt cessation for minor nuisance effects
Stopping without informing the monitoring team
Pregnancy discovery panic stops without specialist input
Restarting at old dose after long gaps without levels
